title: Decision-Relevant Information in Partially Observed Production Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.29905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A production network can remain largely unidentified even when the economic decision it supports is identified. We characterize sufficient measurements for exposure-based decisions and compute sharp maximum regret over networks consistent with released totals. Using earlier and later vintages of Japan's interregional input-output accounts, we select measurements from the 1995 table and evaluate the frozen design against the 2005 benchmark. At roughly half the statistics required for full disclosure, the resulting monitoring set loses only 0.07 percentage points of average exposure relative to the benchmark optimum, yet its sharp maximum regret across compatible networks is 4.83 points. In U.S. coal deliveries surrounding a 2005 Wyoming rail disruption, additional shipment measurements identify the optimal set of plants to monitor for inventory risk, even though four monitored plants' exposures to the affected coal supply remain unidentif

translated_title: 部分观测生产网络中的决策相关信息
translated_abstract: 即使生产网络所支持的经济决策是可识别的，生产网络本身在很大程度上仍可能是不可识别的。我们刻画了基于敞口的决策所需的充分测量指标，并计算了与公布的总量数据相一致的所有网络上的精确最大遗憾值。利用日本区域间投入产出账户的早期和后期版本，我们从1995年表中选取测量指标，并将冻结后的设计与2005年基准进行对比评估。在使用的统计数据约为完全披露所需量一半的情况下，由此得到的监测集相对于基准最优解仅损失0.07个百分点的平均敞口，但其在所有兼容网络上的精确最大遗憾值为4.83个点。在2005年怀俄明州铁路中断前后的美国煤炭运输案例中，额外的货运测量指标能够识别出用于监测库存风险的最优工厂集合，尽管其中四个受监测工厂对受影响煤炭供应的敞口仍然无法识别。
tldr: 论文刻画了部分观测生产网络中基于敞口决策的充分测量指标，表明仅使用约一半的统计数据即可构建监测集，平均敞口精度损失仅0.07个百分点，并通过精确最大遗憾值（4.83个点）量化了网络不可识别性带来的风险。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes sufficient measurements for exposure-based decisions in partially observed production networks, showing that a monitoring set built from roughly half the full-disclosure statistics loses only 0.07 percentage points of average exposure, while sharp maximum regret of 4.83 points quantifies the cost of network non-identification.
